title: VideoKit edit project snapshot, schema 1.0
description: Single source of the edit project snapshot (04A E2, 08 §2.1; M4-B1). The JSON text of SerializedEditProject.json. Both codecs (Kotlin timeline ProjectJson, Dart FakeEditProjectCodec) are tested against this file. Rules that JSON Schema cannot express are in 'x-rules'. Times are microseconds unless named in ms; ranges are always objects {startUs, endUs}, half open [startUs, endUs).
x-rules: W1 Writers write every property defined here (null where nullable), in any order, and nothing else; schemaVersion = 1, schemaMinor = 0.
W2 Runtime state is never written: tracking requestId, projectRevision, kind and progress; the source probe mismatch flag; the phase; the undo/redo history.
W3 A tracking run in progress is written as CANCELLED (it restarts after restore, 08 §6); writers never write RUNNING.

R1 The version is the payload's schemaVersion; when the payload has none, the envelope's SerializedEditProject.schemaVersion. A version above the reader's major (checked on the envelope too) is rejected with UNSUPPORTED_SNAPSHOT_VERSION. A lower version is migrated step by step; a version without a migration path is rejected with UNSUPPORTED_SNAPSHOT_VERSION.
R2 Any schemaMinor of the same major is readable; unknown properties are ignored at every level (minor additions).

R3 A missing optional property reads as its 'default'. A missing 'required' property, a wrong type, or text that is not a JSON object is rejected with INVALID_ARGUMENT (04A V7); diagnostics never contain snapshot content.
R4 Unknown enum values (from a newer minor) read as the enum's 'x-unknown' value.
R5 A restored project has no undo/redo history; its revision is the snapshot's; ids generated after restore continue after the highest numeric id suffix in the snapshot.
R6 RUNNING read from a snapshot (only hand-made data) is treated as CANCELLED.

M0 Schema 0 is synthetic (no build wrote it) and exists to test the migration framework: v1 without schemaVersion, schemaMinor, createdAt, updatedAt; mask rangeUs and acceptedRanges items may be arrays [startUs, endUs]; coverage items carry 'state' instead of 'quality' and an 'accepted' flag; tracking entries may carry runtime fields. v0 to v1: ranges become objects, coverage items with accepted = true are appended to the mask's acceptedRanges, 'state' becomes 'quality', runtime fields are dropped, createdAt / updatedAt default to 0.

exportPresetId.description: Last used export preset (ORIGINAL | P1080 | P720), or null.

videoCodec.description: MIME type; null or empty when unknown.

region.description: Normalized 0..1 to the rotation-corrected source frame; (x, y) is the top-left corner before rotation around the center.

acceptedRanges.description: Ranges the user accepted although tracking did not cover them (09 §4).

state.description: Quality of a tracker keyframe; null for user keyframes.

trackingQuality.description: Tracking quality shared by keyframe 'state' and coverage 'quality' (04A E2 5, 09 §1, §3, §4). NOT_ANALYZED: frames not analysed (never counts as covered). LOST, AMBIGUOUS and NOT_ANALYZED block export unless corrected or accepted.
